items.title: Lillian De Pass Interview, 1960-06-20
items.q: So Piku got together with all of them and said he was going to compose a song... So, Piku made a song... So, Piku, they got together and they made a song. They was going to name it, See For Yourself.

ctx.x: Eh? Piku, you know Piku, huh? Piku. He's right there, over there, Robinson Street.
Yeah, the horn around. Still blowing his horn. That's why he's living. And he drinks like Samson. Oh man, Piku. Did he play with your husband? Oh! Oh! Oh!
Sorry, that was one of them main friends.
